notes: Page index 0 is the cover, index 10 the closing photo with the safety pointer and index 11 a blank back cover. Guide pages: index 1 (step 1), 2-3 (step 2), 4-6 (step 3), 7 (step 4), 8 (step 5), 9 (step 6). Part letters restart on every step, so part keys are "s<step>-<letter>" and the printed letter is kept in printedLabel. Steps 2 and 3 are marked "(opcional)" in the title. Tools: soldador y estaño (not included), tijeras (scissors, visible in the photos but not named), a lighter or heat source to burn the tube ends and to shrink the tubing is NOT named in the manual and is therefore not listed. Printed measurements and quantities: heat-shrink pieces 2 cm; motor cable lengths Y 20, X 30, Z 60 cm; cable sleeve lengths 32, 12, 10, 15, 15 cm; limit switch cables 20 cm and 40 cm; power supply cable 1,10 m, 100 W, INPUT 100-240V AC 1,8A 50-60Hz, OUTPUT 12V DC 8.0A; M3 nut DIN 934; M3 x 18 screw DIN 912. Page 7 table row "Motor del Eje X con el final de carrera del Eje Y 12" and page 9 text are the same data in two places.

steps.summary: Prepare the power supply cable: connect the two-wire cable to the jack adapter terminals (red to +, black to -) and join it to the power supply jack.
Optional: cut each motor cable to length, slide a 2 cm heat-shrink piece on each wire, solder and shrink (twelve pictures over two pages).
steps.ambiguityNote: Marked optional in the title. Twelve photo frames over two pages (1-3 on page 3, 4-12 on page 4); a model may cite either page first. The alternative region covers frames 4-12.

steps.summary: Optional: cut the cable sleeve to the lengths in the table, thread the cables through it and fit a cable tie at each end.
steps.ambiguityNote: Marked optional. The step starts on page 5 (title and parts), its photos 1-4 and the length table are on page 6 and photo 5 with the labelled cable bundles is on page 7; the key region is photos 1-4 on page 6 and the alternative is the bundle picture on page 7.

steps.summary: Connect the motors and limit switches to the board following the wiring diagram.
Route the cables through the machine as shown in the five close-up pictures.
steps.ambiguityNote: One composite picture: a small overview photo and five circular close-ups joined by dashed lines. A single close-up circle is also defensible; the key region is the whole composite so a panel covering only one circle will score as wrong, which is a deliberate strictness.

steps.summary: Screw the electronics cover to the base (screws go in from underneath).

warnings.text: Conecta el cable rojo con la clema con el símbolo ‘ + ‘ y el cable negro con la clema con el símbolo ‘ - ‘.
Quema los extremos del tubo para evitar que se deshilache.
Coloca una brida en cada extremo del tubo recogecables.
Pon atención, ya que una mala conexión de los conectores de los finales de carrera puede dañar la placa.
En los conectores de los motores, fíjate en la orientación del cable negro a la hora de conectarlos a la placa. El color del resto de los cables puede variar.
Introduce el conector del cable del final de carrera por el orificio de la base, guíalo por la ranura y conéctalo.
Para realizar este paso, retira previamente el conector de la fuente de alimentación.
Los tornillos se insertan desde la parte inferior de la base.
Antes de empezar a fresar, lee las indicaciones de seguridad descritas en la Garantía
warnings.ambiguityNote: Closing safety pointer on the last content page (the sentence continues "y visita: http://diwo.bq.com/product/cyclone"). Not tied to a step; key text stops before "y visita" so a quote of the whole sentence also matches.
